decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several types of backpacks ranging from daily slings and school bags to heavy-duty hiking packs. The SHENHU 40L Hiking Backpack (prod_backpacks_111) stood out as the best value option. It offers a substantial 40L capacity, is waterproof, and has high ratings (4.5) for a very accessible price of $26.99. While the Maxpedition (prod_backpacks_096) is likely higher quality, its $171 price point is significantly higher. The adidas mesh bag (prod_backpacks_128) is reputable but niche due to the mesh design. The SHENHU provides the best balance of utility, positive feedback, and cost for a general-purpose outdoor or travel backpack.
